name: Inspiring Statuary
oracle_text: Nonartifact spells you cast have improvise. (Your artifacts can help cast those spells. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)
blocked_sentences: Nonartifact spells you cast have improvise

needs.what: a player-wide static that grants a pay_generic_with currency (here "tap_artifacts", improvise) to spells its controller casts that match an affects_spells filter (not_types: ["Artifact"]), so the cast offers the tap-artifacts-to-pay-{1} line for those spells as if each had printed improvise
needs.why_existing_wont_do: pay_generic_with is a card-level cost key read only off the spell's own CardDef (casting.py / game.py check card.pay_generic_with), so it cannot be conferred by another permanent; no static in static_effects grants it (spell_cost_reduction is a flat discount, not tapping artifacts; granted_alternative_cost replaces the cost rather than adding a payment currency; cast_gains_keywords only grants battlefield keywords like haste), and improvise is not in the keyword list
